tandem keys (agents in sidebar, main grid, status below)

Global (tmux)
  Help      Opt+h        open this help
  Agents    Ctrl+Opt+n   add an agent
            Ctrl+Opt+w   close the focused agent (asks first)
            Ctrl+Opt+r   restart an exited agent
  Tabs      Opt+Up       previous agent (sidebar order), shown alone
            Opt+Down     next agent (sidebar order), shown alone
  Status    Opt+s        focus the status window
            Opt+q        open the Queries tab
  Columns   Opt+1        show last planner
            Opt+2        show last implementer
  Quit      Ctrl+Opt+x   exit menu: save and exit, detach, update tandem, discard
  Layout    Ctrl+Opt+z   resize mode: arrows resize the focused pane, = resets, Enter exits
  Sidebar   Opt+b        focus the sidebar (popup when hidden)
  Settings  Opt+,        open Settings (grid, sidebar, Reset UI)

Sidebar & Grid
  Grid      Opt+PgUp / Opt+PgDn scroll the grid one row
  Equalize  double-click a border, or Ctrl+Opt+z then e

Status & Queries window
  Status    Tab          switch between tabs (1-6 direct)
            Opt+r        refresh the status now
            Opt+g        go to the highlighted or asking agent's pane
  Queries   Enter        answer the selected open question
            1-9          fill the answer with a numbered option
            Ctrl+S       send the answer
            Opt+w        mark the selected question withdrawn
            Esc          clear the draft and return to the list

Launch / add-agent wizard
  Model     Opt+f        focus the model filter
  Summary   Opt+a        add another agent
            Opt+d        delete the highlighted agent
            Shift+L      launch all configured agents
            Esc          back or cancel

Mouse
            click agent = show · Shift/Opt+click = add to grid · right-click menu
            double-click a border to equalize
            click a status-bar hint = press its key
            click a pane to focus it; drag a border to resize; scroll wheel scrolls
  Resize    Ctrl+Opt+z then arrows (←→ 5 columns, ↑↓ 2 rows) on the focused pane; = resets; Enter exits
  Custom    set TANDEM_KEYS="help=Ctrl+Opt+h,quit=Ctrl+Opt+q" (each needs at least one modifier)
  Detach    your agents keep running; run `tandem` again to re-attach
